faq.title: Questions about your subscription
faq.description: Learn how Postmade subscription pricing, limits, and changes work.

pricing.question: How is the subscription price calculated?
pricing.answer: The subscription includes 3 channels and 1 member for US$19 per month. Each additional channel costs US$2 per month and each additional member costs US$8 per month. The amount shown at checkout prevails over the estimate in the application.

trial.question: What is included in the free trial?
trial.answer: The trial lasts 15 days and includes 3 channels, 1 member, and up to 3 posts. The workspace owner counts as the included member.

memberUsage.question: Who counts toward the member limit?
memberUsage.answer: The owner, other workspace members, and pending invitations count toward the contracted limit. Revoke invitations that will not be used to free up spots.

changeSubscription.question: Can I change the number of channels and members later?
changeSubscription.answer: Yes. Once the subscription is active, change the quantities in Postmade's configurator. The backend validates usage, updates Stripe, and the new quotas take effect after payment confirmation.

reduceQuantities.question: Why can't I reduce a quantity?
reduceQuantities.answer: The new quantity cannot be lower than current usage. Disconnect channels, remove members, or revoke pending invitations before requesting a reduction.
